decisions.reason: As a very recent and visibly promoted launch, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is likely to be given more time because the firm has already invested in it and can plausibly attribute any weak uptake to normal industrial ramp-up delays.
The automatic de-shuttering robot was only launched in 2023 and publicly presented on the website, so management is likely to persist with it rather than admit failure after such a short market test.

Although the profile storage robot may be somewhat less central than the core shuttering robots, the firm’s recent investment and public commitment still make withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.

The automatic shuttering robot fits the firm’s announced robotics offering, and in a German machinery business with long customer adoption cycles management would usually continue backing it for longer.
